generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: 112 kWh gross / 107 kWh usable, 800 V; DC listed as 350 kW (MY2024 text) or 430 kW (infobox), 22 kW AC. Launched globally for MY2024; North America only in NRCan from MY2026 (S and R, each "Long Range" and "Performance"; Auto123 reports NRCan ranges 422-467 km and calls it 2027). Lotus says the 2026 update kept the same pack. No EPA rows. first_year is the first North American year. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lotus_Eletre ; https://www.auto123.com/en/news/2027-lotus-eletre-range-canada/74128/
